intro: Venezuela's government is in transition after years of authoritarian rule.

chapters.title: How it works
text: Under Chávez and Maduro, power was concentrated in the presidency and the courts and electoral authority were controlled by the ruling party. After Maduro's capture in 2026, Delcy Rodríguez became acting president, and the country's future government remains uncertain.

chapters.title: Opposition
text: Opposition leader María Corina Machado won the 2025 Nobel Peace Prize.
